question: What is the meaning of modularity in relation to ease of repair and maintenance?
description:
Modularity refers to the design of buildings in prefabricated sections that can be assembled using demountable or fixed connections. This approach allows for easier repair and maintenance, as individual components can be replaced or repaired without affecting the entire structure. In the context of the study, modularity is considered in two types of connections: dry connections, which are demountable parts that enable connected building elements to be dismantled and reused, and wet connections, which involve permanent connections. The study aims to compare the results of traditional cast-in-place buildings with modular buildings to test the efficiency of provided indicators related to ease of repair and maintenance. <|ENDINPUT>
